sloka: तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवस्य महात्मनः ।कुम्भयोनिर्मिहातेजा राममेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.२.१ ॥
transliteration: tasya tadvacanaṁ śrutvā rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ ।kumbhayonirmihātejā rāmametaduvāca ha ।। 7.2.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard those words of the great-souled Rama, the greatly effulgent sage Agastya then spoke this to Rama.
